basis: The routing criterion is the 'Highest prevalence state in the dashboard'. The legend maps pale yellow to 'High' (100) and dark burgundy to 'Low' (0). The observation and O/B checks confirm that Delaware (DE) is colored pale yellow, corresponding to the highest end of the scale, while Georgia (GA) is dark burgundy (low) and Rhode Island (RI) is a medium shade. Therefore, Delaware is the state with the highest prevalence among the options and should be routed to the priority follow-up workflow.
